title: Briefing for 2026-11-07
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-07: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%. The October jobs report is out Friday. Here's everything to expect. Here's what the Democratic election rout could mean for the U.S. economy. Bank of England hikes interest rate for the first time since Iran war, warns inflation will near 5%. Voters say the economy drove them to the polls — and blame Trump for their troubles. Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it.
global: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values. Four midterms takeaways for 2028 White House race. Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say. Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster. Russian extremist group denies sending hoax bomb threats. The engine parts that 'fight the laws of the universe'.
philippines: Jacobina: More than a biscuit, the pride of Mendez town. 5 dead in Malasiqui fireworks factory blast: What we know so far. [Vantage Point] Gov’t dismantling a grid monopoly is only half the job. Meet the Bugkalot in Nagtipunan, Quirino.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
